name: Devourer
description: Devourers are hulking cousins of rotfiends that gather near corpses and battlefields. They crush prey with brute force, gorge on the fallen and become explosive hazards when mortally wounded.
story: The feast ends only when the devourer's swollen corpse bursts.
lore: They often mingle with rotfiends and can overwhelm a lone fighter through sheer mass. When a devourer begins to choke and its head swells, distance is wiser than one final sword stroke—the ensuing blast can tear through monster and witcher alike.
